blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: بَلِّغُوا عَنِّي وَلَوْ آيَةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البخاري ، باب ما ذكر عن بني اسرائيل، رقم:٣٤٦١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Even if what you have heard from me is a single sentence, convey that too to others.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Convey the words of Deen to others as much as you are able. Even if the message you tell others is small, they may receive guidance through it, and its reward will also come to you. You will be honoured with countless rewards; this is the meaning of this hadith.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ بْنِ عَائِذٍ ﵁: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا بَعَثَ بَعْثاً قَالَ: تَأَلَّفُوا النَّاسَ، وَتَأَنَّوْا بِهِمْ، وَلَا تُغِيرُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حَتَّي تَدْعُوَهُمْ فَمَا عَلَي اْلاَرْضِ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ مَدَرٍ وَلَا وَبَرٍ إِلَّا وَأَنْ تَأْتُونِي بِهِمْ مُسْلِمِينَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ تَقْتُلُوا رِجَالَهُمْ، وَتَأْتُونِي بِنسَائِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: المطالب العالية:٢ /١٦٦، وذكر صاحب الاصابة بنحوه:٣ /١٥٢.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Create affection among the people, win their love, deal with them gently, and do not wage war on them without inviting them to Islam. For, of all the huts and houses there are (all the towns or villages there are), bringing all of their inhabitants to me as Muslims is far dearer to me than killing their men and bringing their women to me (as captives),” Rasulullah ﷺ would say when sending out an army, as Hazrat Abdur Rahman ibn
